description: Start a run of a saved test now and read its result: the status and what each step did. A run that fails may be tried again by Monity (its retries): the answer lists the attempts. Costs credits (one for each started minute).

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the run here, in seconds (default 40, at most 90). A run not finished by then comes back with its runUuid: ask again with get_test_run.

name: run_test
title: Run a test now
